exercises.instructionEn: American English - British English Guide: Cars and Driving, Travelling/Commuting, Food, Others.
exercises.instructionUz: Amerika-Britaniya inglizchasi qo'llanmasi: mashina va haydash, sayohat, ovqat, boshqalar.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — YANGI MA'LUMOTNOMA BO'LIMI.

  Kitobning oxirida AmE (Amerika) va BrE
  (Britaniya) inglizchasi farqlari jadval
  qilib berilgan.

  Bu betda TO'RT bo'lim bor:
     • Cars and Driving (24 juft)
     • Travelling/Commuting (9 juft)
     • Food (18 juft)
     • Others — boshlanishi (davomi
       165-betda)


⚠ NEGA IKKI XIL INGLIZChA BOR:

  Ingliz tili Amerikaga 400 yil oldin
  borgan va u yerda O'ZIChA rivojlangan.
  Natijada ba'zi so'zlar ikki mamlakatda
  BOShQAChA.

  ⚠ Bu — ikki TIL emas, BIR tilning ikki
  KO'RINIShI. Amerikaliklar va
  britaniyaliklar bir-birini bemalol
  tushunadi.


⚠ QAYSI BIRINI O'RGANISh KERAK?

  ⚠ Enterprise kitobi BRITANIYA
  inglizchasida yozilgan — shuning uchun
  asosiy so'zlar BrE.

  ⚠ Lekin filmlar va internetda AmE
  ko'proq uchraydi — IKKALASINI ham
  TANISH kerak.

  ⚠ Gapirganda esa bittasiga sodiq
  qoling — aralashtirmaslik yaxshi.


⚠ KITOBDA OLDIN UChRAGAN JUFTLAR:

  Bu jadval kitob davomida aytilgan
  farqlarni rasman umumlashtiradi:

     French fries / chips    (Photo File 8-unit varag'i)
     potato chips / crisps   (Photo File 8-unit varag'i)
     cookie / biscuit        (159-bet)
     apartment / flat        (Photo File 3-unit varag'i)


⚠ KITOB XATOSI (tinish belgisi):

  'Others' bo'limida:
     'call, phone → ring up, phone,call'

  ⚠ Oxirgi VERGULDAN KEYIN BO'Sh JOY
  qo'yilmagan. To'g'risi:
     'ring up, phone, call'


⚠ ENG MUHIM 10 JUFT (bu betdan):

   AmE            BrE
   ─────────────  ─────────────
   gas            petrol
   truck          lorry
   cab            taxi
   subway         underground
   sidewalk       pavement
   apartment      flat
   French fries   chips
   candy          sweets
   cookie         biscuit
   attorney       solicitor


⚠⚠ ENG XAVFLI JUFT — 'SUBWAY':

     AmE 'subway' = METRO
     BrE 'subway' = YER OSTI PIYODA
                    O'TISh JOYI!

  ⚠ Londonda metro 'the Underground'
  yoki 'the Tube' deyiladi.

  ⚠ Londonda 'subway' belgisini ko'rsangiz
  — bu piyoda o'tish joyi, metro EMAS!


⚠⚠ 'BILLION' — TARIXIY FARQ:

  Jadvalda:
     AmE: billion = thousand million
          (milliard, 10⁹)
     BrE: billion = million million
          (10¹²)

  ⚠ DIQQAT: bu ESKI Britaniya tizimi.
  HOZIRGI Britaniyada ham AmE ma'nosi
  qabul qilingan: billion = milliard.

  ⚠ Kitob yozilgan davrda eski farq hali
  eslatib o'tilar edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR (asosiylari):
  a guide     = qo'llanma
  petrol      = benzin (BrE)
  a lorry     = yuk mashinasi (BrE)
  a motorway  = avtomagistral (BrE)
  a roundabout = aylanma chorraha (BrE)
  the underground = metro (BrE)
  a pavement  = piyodalar yo'lkasi (BrE)
  a solicitor = advokat (BrE)
  a rucksack  = ryukzak (BrE)
  sweets      = shirinliklar (BrE)
  a courgette = kabachok (BrE)
  an aubergine = baqlajon (BrE)

tasks.en: American English - British English Guide: Cars and Driving, Travelling/Commuting, Food, Others.
tasks.uz: Amerika-Britaniya inglizchasi qo'llanmasi: mashina va haydash, sayohat, ovqat, boshqalar.

tasks.en: American English and British English are two varieties of the same language.
tasks.uz: Amerika va Britaniya inglizchasi — bir tilning ikki ko'rinishi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Bu — ikki TIL emas. Amerikaliklar va
britaniyaliklar bir-birini bemalol
tushunadi.

⚠ Enterprise kitobi BRITANIYA inglizchasida
yozilgan.

⚠ Maslahat: ikkalasini TANING, lekin
gapirganda bittasiga sodiq qoling.

tasks.en: AmE 'subway' = BrE 'underground, tube'  —  BUT BrE 'subway' = an underpass!
tasks.uz: AmE 'subway' = metro; LEKIN BrE da 'subway' — yer osti piyoda o'tish joyi!
tasks.note:
⚠⚠ ENG XAVFLI JUFT!

Londonda 'subway' belgisi PIYODA O'TISH
JOYini bildiradi, metro emas.

London metrosi: 'the Underground' yoki
'the Tube'.

⚠ Jadvalning o'zida ham bor:
AmE 'underpass' = BrE 'subway'.

tasks.en: AmE 'gas, gasoline' = BrE 'petrol';  AmE 'gas station' = BrE 'petrol station, garage'.
tasks.uz: AmE 'gas' = BrE 'petrol' (benzin); 'gas station' = 'petrol station' (yoqilg'i shoxobchasi).
tasks.note:
⚠ AmE 'gas' — 'gasoline' ning qisqartmasi.

⚠ ADASHTIRMANG: 'gas' BrE da ham bor, lekin
u GAZ (havo holatidagi modda) degani.

⚠ 'a garage' BrE da ta'mirlash ustaxonasi
ham.

tasks.en: AmE 'French fries' = BrE 'chips';  AmE 'potato chips' = BrE 'crisps'.
tasks.uz: AmE 'French fries' = BrE 'chips' (kartoshka fri); AmE 'chips' = BrE 'crisps' (chipsi).
tasks.note:
⚠ Photo File 8-unit varag'ida ko'rgan juftimiz — endi jadvalda
rasman.

AYLANMA:
  AmE fries  = BrE chips
  AmE chips  = BrE crisps

⚠ 'fish and chips' — britancha taom nomi,
shuning uchun 'chips'.

tasks.en: AmE 'billion = thousand million'; BrE 'billion = million million'.
tasks.uz: AmE 'billion' = ming million (milliard); eski BrE 'billion' = million million.
tasks.note:
⚠⚠ TARIXIY FARQ.

HOZIRGI Britaniyada ham AmE ma'nosi qabul
qilingan: billion = MILLIARD (10⁹).

⚠ Kitob yozilgan davrda eski farq hali
eslatib o'tilar edi. Bugun 'billion' hamma
joyda milliard.

tasks.en: call, phone  =  ring up, phone, call
tasks.uz: qo'ng'iroq qilmoq: AmE 'call' = BrE 'ring up'
tasks.note:
⚠ KITOB XATOSI: kitobda 'ring up,
phone,call' — oxirgi verguldan keyin BO'SH
JOY qo'yilmagan.

⚠ 'to ring up' = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq (BrE):
'I'll ring you up tomorrow.'

⚠ 'ring' TARTIBSIZ: ring - rang - rung.

exercises.instructionEn: Cars and Driving: match the American English word to its British English equivalent.
exercises.instructionUz: Mashina va haydash: Amerika inglizchasidagi so'zni Britaniya muqobili bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'CARS AND DRIVING' BO'LIMI — 24 JUFT.

  Quyida eng muhim juftlar mashq qilinadi.
  To'liq ro'yxat tepadagi tushuntirishda.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT (AmE → BrE):

  antenna        → aerial
  circle, rotary → roundabout
  defroster      → window heater
  detour         → diversion
  divided highway → dual carriageway
  fender         → wing
  flat (tire)    → flat tyre, puncture
  gas, gasoline  → petrol
  gas station    → petrol station, garage
  gear shift     → gear lever, stick
  high beams     → full lights
  hood           → bonnet
  intersection   → crossroads
  interstate, highway, freeway → motorway
  low beams      → lights dipped
  minibus        → van/minibus
  motorcycle     → motorbike, motorcycle
  overpass       → flyover
  parking lot    → car park
  pass (vehicle) → overtake, pass
  pedestrian crossing → zebra crossing,
                   pedestrian crossing
  rental car     → hire car
  transmission   → gear box
  truck          → lorry, van
  turn signals   → indicators
  windshield     → windscreen


⚠ QIZIQ JUFTLAR:

  'hood' / 'bonnet' — ikkalasi ham
  KIYIM nomi (kapyushon / ayollar
  qalpoqchasi). Mashina kapoti ustki
  qopqoq bo'lgani uchun shunday atalgan.

  'zebra crossing' — oq-qora chiziqlari
  ZEBRA terisiga o'xshagani uchun.

  'tire' (AmE) / 'tyre' (BrE) — bir so'z,
  IKKI XIL IMLO.


⚠ IMLO FARQI HAM BOR:

     AmE tire  = BrE tyre
     (g'ildirak shinasi)

  ⚠ 156-betdagi 'color/colour' kabi —
  ba'zi so'zlar faqat IMLOda farq qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Travelling and Food: match the American English word to its British English equivalent.
exercises.instructionUz: Sayohat va ovqat: Amerika inglizchasidagi so'zni Britaniya muqobili bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'TRAVELLING/COMMUTING' — 9 JUFT:

  airplane        → aeroplane
  baggage claim   → baggage reclaim
  bus             → coach
  cab             → taxi
  one-way (ticket) → single
  railroad        → railway
  round trip (ticket) → return (ticket)
  sidewalk        → pavement
  subway          → underground, tube
  underpass       → subway


'FOOD' — 18 JUFT:

  appetizers      → starters
  baked potato    → jacket potato
  broil           → grill
  candy           → sweets
  candy store     → confectioner,
                    sweet shop
  canned          → tinned
  cookie          → biscuit
  corn            → sweetcorn, maize
  cotton candy    → candy floss
  dessert         → pudding, sweet,
                    dessert
  eggplant        → aubergine
  fish sticks     → fish fingers
  French fries    → chips
  ground meat     → mince
  jello           → jelly
  jelly           → jam
  oatmeal         → porridge
  potato chips    → crisps
  preserves       → conserves
  without or with (milk/cream in coffee)
                  → black or white
  zucchini        → courgettes


⚠⚠ 'JELLY' — AYLANMA TUZOQ:

     AmE jello  = BrE jelly   (jele)
     AmE jelly  = BrE jam     (murabbo)

  ⚠ Amerikada 'jelly' — MURABBO,
  Britaniyada esa — JELE!

  ⚠ 'chips' bilan bir xil aylanma holat.


⚠ 'JACKET POTATO' — QIZIQ NOM:

  BrE 'jacket potato' = po'sti bilan
  pishirilgan kartoshka.

  ⚠ 'a jacket' = kurtka — kartoshkaning
  PO'STI uning 'kurtkasi'!


⚠ 'BLACK OR WHITE' — QAHVA:

  Britaniyada qahva so'ralganda:
     'black' = sutsiz
     'white' = sut bilan

  ⚠ Amerikada esa: 'with or without
  milk/cream' deb so'raladi.


⚠ SABZAVOT NOMLARI — FRANSUZ IZI:

     BrE aubergine  (fransuzchadan)
     AmE eggplant   ('tuxum o'simligi' —
        oq navlari tuxumga o'xshagan)

     BrE courgette  (fransuzchadan)
     AmE zucchini   (italyanchadan)

  ⚠ Britaniya — Fransiyaga yaqin,
  Amerikada esa italyan muhojirlari
  ko'p bo'lgan. So'zlar shundan.

exercises.instructionUz: Boshqalar (davomi): yana 90 ga yaqin AmE-BrE juftligi.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — QO'LLANMANING OXIRGI BETI.

  'Others' bo'limining davomi — ikki
  betlik ustunlarda 90 ga yaqin juft.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT (AmE → BrE), ChAP USTUN:

  clippings       → cuttings
  closet          → cupboard
  closet (hanging clothes) → wardrobe
  connect (telephone) → put through
  counter clockwise → anticlockwise
  crazy           → mad
  crib (for a baby) → cot
  davenport, sofa, couch → sofa, settee,
                    couch
  desk clerk      → receptionist
  dish towel      → tea towel
  down town       → centre (city/business)
  drapes          → curtains
  dresser         → chest of drawers
  druggist        → chemist
  drugstore, pharmacy → chemist's (shop)
  overalls        → jeans, dungarees
  duplex          → semi-detached
  elevator        → lift
  equip, fit out  → fit (v)
  eraser          → rubber, eraser
  fall            → autumn
  faucet          → tap
  fire (v)        → sack
  first floor, second floor etc →
     ground floor, first floor etc
  flashlight      → torch
  freshman        → 1st year undergraduate
  front desk      → reception
  garbage, trash  → rubbish
  garbage can     → dustbin, bin
  garters         → suspenders
  grade           → class, form
  intermission    → interval
  janitor         → caretaker, porter
  jump rope       → skipping rope
  laundromat      → laundrette
  lay off (v)     → make redundant
  layoff          → redundancy
  line            → queue
  lost and found  → lost property
  mail            → post
  mailman         → postman
  make a reservation → book
  math            → maths
  movie           → film
  movie house/theater → cinema
  news stand      → newsagent
  non-profit-organization → charity


O'NG USTUN:

  nothing, zero   → nil
  office (doctor's) → surgery
  on line         → on stream
  open house      → open day
  overalls        → dungarees
  pacifier        → dummy
  pants, trousers → trousers
  pantyhose, nylons → tights
  parka           → anorak
  pocketbook      → purse, wallet
  polo neck       → roll neck, polo neck
  pool (billiards) → snooker
  principal       → headmaster
  public school   → state school
  purse           → handbag
  rent (a car)    → hire (a car)
  reservations    → bookings
  rest room       → toilet, cloakroom,
                    public convenience
  run (for election) → stand
  sack lunch      → packed lunch
  sales clerk     → shop assistant
  schedule        → timetable
  Scotch tape     → Sellotape
  shopping cart   → shopping trolley
  shorts (underwear) → pants
  sick            → ill
  sleep in        → lie in
  sneakers        → trainers
  soccer          → football
  sports          → sport
  stand in line   → queue
  store, shop     → shop
  suspenders      → braces
  telephone booth → telephone box
  trash bag       → bin liner
  tricky          → dodgy
  tuition         → fee
  two weeks       → fortnight, two weeks
  undershirt      → vest
  vacation        → holiday
  vacuum (n, v)   → hoover (n, v)
  vest            → waistcoat
  yard            → garden
  z ('zee')       → z ('zed')
  zero            → nought, oh
  zip code        → post code


⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM JUFTLAR:

   AmE           BrE
   ────────────  ────────────
   elevator      lift
   fall          autumn
   movie         film
   soccer        football
   vacation      holiday
   sick          ill
   line          queue
   sneakers      trainers
   mail          post
   math          maths


⚠⚠ XAVFLI JUFTLAR (bir so'z — ikki
  mamlakatda BOShQA narsa):

  1) PANTS:
     AmE 'pants' = ShIM
     BrE 'pants' = IChKI KIYIM!
     ⚠ Britaniyada shim — 'trousers'.

  2) VEST:
     AmE 'vest' = nimcha (kostyum osti)
     BrE 'vest' = MAYKA (ichki kiyim)
     ⚠ Britaniyada nimcha — 'waistcoat'.

  3) SUSPENDERS:
     AmE 'suspenders' = shim ushlagich
     BrE 'suspenders' = paypoq ushlagich!
     ⚠ Britaniyada shim ushlagich —
     'braces'.

  4) PUBLIC SCHOOL:
     AmE 'public school' = DAVLAT maktabi
     BrE 'public school' = XUSUSIY
        QIMMAT maktab (Eton kabi)!
     ⚠ Britaniyada davlat maktabi —
     'state school'.

  5) FIRST FLOOR:
     AmE = yerdagi qavat
     BrE = yerdan YUQORIDAGI qavat
     ⚠ Photo File 3-unit varag'ida ko'rganmiz.


⚠ 'Z' HARFI:

     AmE: 'zee' [zi:]
     BrE: 'zed' [zed]

  ⚠ Alifboning oxirgi harfi ikki mamlakatda
  BOShQAChA o'qiladi!


⚠ 'FORTNIGHT' — QIZIQ SO'Z:

  BrE 'a fortnight' = IKKI HAFTA

  ⚠ Qadimgi inglizcha 'feowertyne niht'
  (o'n to'rt kecha) dan qisqargan.

  ⚠ Amerikada bu so'z deyarli
  ishlatilmaydi.


⚠ 'HOOVER' — BREND NOMIDAN FE'L:

  BrE 'to hoover' = changyutgich bilan
  tozalamoq.

  ⚠ 'Hoover' — changyutgich kompaniyasi
  nomi edi; so'z tilga singib ketgan.

  ⚠ Shu kabi: 'Sellotape' (skotch) ham
  brend nomi.


⚠ KITOB TAKRORI:

  'overalls' IKKI MARTA berilgan:
     chapda:  overalls → jeans, dungarees
     o'ngda:  overalls → dungarees

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, shunchaki
  takror.


YANGI SO'ZLAR (asosiylari):
  a lift       = lift (BrE)
  autumn       = kuz (BrE)
  a film       = kino (BrE)
  football     = futbol (BrE)
  a holiday    = ta'til (BrE)
  ill          = kasal (BrE)
  a queue      = navbat (BrE)
  trainers     = krossovka (BrE)
  the post     = pochta (BrE)
  a torch      = fonar (BrE)
  rubbish      = axlat (BrE)
  a fortnight  = ikki hafta (BrE)
  a timetable  = dars jadvali (BrE)
  to book      = band qilmoq (BrE)
  a rubber     = o'chirg'ich (BrE)

tasks.en: Others (continued): about 90 more AmE-BrE pairs.
tasks.uz: Boshqalar (davomi): yana 90 ga yaqin AmE-BrE juftligi.

tasks.en: AmE 'pants' = BrE 'trousers'  —  BUT BrE 'pants' = underwear!
tasks.uz: AmE 'pants' = shim; LEKIN BrE da 'pants' — ichki kiyim!
tasks.note:
⚠⚠ ENG KULGILI XATO ChIQIShI MUMKIN BO'LGAN
JUFT.

Britaniyada 'I like your pants' desangiz —
ichki kiyim haqida gapirgan bo'lasiz!

Britaniyada shim — 'TROUSERS'.

⚠ Jadvalda ham bor: AmE 'shorts (underwear)'
= BrE 'pants'.

tasks.en: AmE 'public school' = BrE 'state school'  —  BUT BrE 'public school' = an expensive private school!
tasks.uz: AmE 'public school' = davlat maktabi; BrE da esa 'public school' — qimmat XUSUSIY maktab!
tasks.note:
⚠⚠ ENG PARADOKSAL JUFT.

Britaniyada 'public school' — Eton, Harrow
kabi QIMMAT XUSUSIY maktablar!

Davlat maktabi esa 'STATE school'.

⚠ Tarixiy sabab: bu maktablar qadimda
'hammaga ochiq' (public) bo'lgani uchun
shunday atalgan.

tasks.en: AmE 'elevator' = BrE 'lift';  AmE 'fall' = BrE 'autumn';  AmE 'movie' = BrE 'film'.
tasks.uz: AmE 'elevator' = BrE 'lift'; 'fall' = 'autumn' (kuz); 'movie' = 'film'.
tasks.note:
⚠ Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan uch juft.

⚠ AmE 'fall' — barglar TUSHISHI ('to fall')
dan olingan.

⚠ 'movie' — 'moving picture' (harakatlanuvchi
surat) qisqartmasi.

tasks.en: AmE 'soccer' = BrE 'football'.
tasks.uz: AmE 'soccer' = BrE 'football' (futbol).
tasks.note:
⚠ Amerikada 'football' — AMERIKA FUTBOLI
(qo'l bilan o'ynaladigan boshqa sport)!

Biz biladigan futbol u yerda 'soccer'.

⚠ QIZIQ: 'soccer' so'zining o'zi Britaniyada
paydo bo'lgan ('asSOCiation football'
qisqartmasi), keyin u yerda unutilgan.

tasks.en: AmE 'first floor' = BrE 'ground floor'; AmE 'second floor' = BrE 'first floor'.
tasks.uz: AmE 'first floor' = BrE 'ground floor' (yerdagi qavat); AmE 'second floor' = BrE 'first floor'.
tasks.note:
⚠ Photo File 3-unit varag'ida ko'rgan qoidamiz — endi jadvalda
rasman.

BrE: ground floor (yerdagi) → first floor
(undan yuqoridagi).

⚠ Britaniyada 7-qavat — yerdan 8-qavat!

tasks.en: AmE 'z' is pronounced 'zee'; BrE 'z' is pronounced 'zed'.
tasks.uz: AmE da 'z' harfi 'zi' deb, BrE da 'zed' deb o'qiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Alifboning OXIRGI HARFI ikki mamlakatda
boshqacha o'qiladi!

⚠ Nol ham boshqacha: AmE 'zero';
BrE 'nought' yoki 'oh' (telefon raqamlarida:
'oh-seven' = 07).

tasks.en: BrE 'a fortnight' = two weeks.
tasks.uz: BrE 'a fortnight' = ikki hafta.
tasks.note:
⚠ Qadimgi inglizcha 'feowertyne niht'
(O'N TO'RT KECHA) dan qisqargan.

⚠ Britaniyada juda ko'p ishlatiladi:
'See you in a fortnight!'

⚠ Amerikada bu so'z deyarli ishlatilmaydi.

tasks.en: BrE 'to hoover' and 'Sellotape' come from brand names.
tasks.uz: BrE 'to hoover' (chang yutmoq) va 'Sellotape' (skotch) — brend nomlaridan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'Hoover' — changyutgich kompaniyasi;
nomi FE'Lga aylangan: 'to hoover the
carpet'.

⚠ 'Sellotape' (BrE) = 'Scotch tape' (AmE) —
IKKALASI ham brend nomi!

⚠ O'zbekchada ham shunday: 'skotch' —
aslida brend nomi.

exercises.instructionEn: Quick check: choose the British English word.
exercises.instructionUz: Tezkor tekshiruv: Britaniya inglizchasidagi so'zni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUSTAHKAMLASh MAShQI.

  ⚠ Bu mashq kitobda yo'q — ikki betlik
  jadvalni mustahkamlash uchun qo'shildi.

  Har savolda AmE so'z beriladi — BrE
  muqobilini toping.

  ⚠ Enterprise kitobi BrE da yozilgani
  uchun aynan BrE so'zlarini bilish
  muhim.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ BrE 'HOLIDAY' = ta'til.

'I'm going on holiday.' (BrE)
'I'm going on vacation.' (AmE)

⚠ 'a vacancy' — bo'sh ish o'rni (boshqa
so'z!).

⚠ BrE 'QUEUE' [kyu:] = navbat.

⚠ YOZILISHI G'ALATI: 5 harf, lekin bitta
tovush [kyu:]!

'to stand in line' (AmE) =
'to queue' (BrE).

⚠ Britaniyaliklar navbatga juda jiddiy
qarashadi — navbat buzish katta odobsizlik.

⚠ BrE 'TRAINERS' = krossovka.

⚠ AmE 'sneakers' — 'to sneak' (sekin
yurmoq) dan: tovushsiz poyabzal.

⚠ BrE 'trainers' — 'to train' (mashq
qilmoq) dan: sport poyabzali.

⚠ BrE 'RUBBER' = o'chirg'ich.

⚠ EHTIYOT: AmE da 'rubber' butunlay boshqa
narsani bildiradi — maktabda bu so'zni
Amerikada ishlatmang, 'eraser' deng.

⚠ 'rubber' aslida 'to rub' (ishqalamoq)
dan.

tasks.promptUz: AmE 'schedule' (dars jadvali) = BrE da qaysi so'z?
tasks.whyUz:

sections.title: American English - British English Guide (3): Grammar, Spelling, Prepositions

exercises.instructionEn: Grammar: five differences between American and British English.
exercises.instructionUz: Grammatika: Amerika va Britaniya inglizchasi orasidagi besh farq.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ BU BET OLDINGI IKKITASIDAN FARQ
QILADI.

  164-165-betlarda faqat SO'ZLAR ro'yxati
  bor edi.

  Bu yerda esa GRAMMATIKA, IMLO va
  PREDLOG farqlari.


'GRAMMAR' BO'LIMI — 5 JUFT:

  1  AmE: He just left. /
          He has just left.
     BrE: He has just left.

  2  AmE: We saw that film.
     BrE: We have seen that film.

  3  AmE: Did he hand in the report yet?
     BrE: Has he handed in the report yet?

  4  AmE: Hello, is this David?
     BrE: Hello, is that David?

  5  AmE: Do you have a ticket? /
          Have you got a ticket?
     BrE: Have you got a ticket?


⚠⚠ ASOSIY FARQ — PRESENT PERFECT:

  1, 2 va 3-juftlar bir xil qoidaga
  tegishli:

  ⚠ BRITANIYADA 'just', 'yet', 'already'
  bilan PRESENT PERFECT ('have/has +
  3-shakl') ISHLATILADI.

  ⚠ AMERIKADA esa PAST SIMPLE ham
  mumkin.

     BrE: 'He HAS JUST LEFT.'      ✓
     AmE: 'He JUST LEFT.'          ✓ ham

     BrE: 'Have you finished YET?'  ✓
     AmE: 'Did you finish YET?'     ✓ ham

  ⚠ MUHIM: Enterprise kitobi BRITANIYA
  inglizchasida — shuning uchun
  MASHQLARDA PRESENT PERFECT yozing.


⚠ 'JUST', 'YET', 'ALREADY' O'RNI:

     JUST — 'have' bilan asosiy fe'l
        ORASIDA:
        'He has JUST left.'

     ALREADY — xuddi shu joyda:
        'I have ALREADY seen it.'

     YET — gap OXIRIDA (savol va
        inkorda):
        'Has he handed it in YET?'
        'I haven't finished YET.'


⚠⚠ 4-JUFT — TELEFONDA GAPIRISh:

     AmE: 'Hello, is THIS David?'
     BrE: 'Hello, is THAT David?'

  ⚠ Bu — juda amaliy farq!

  ⚠ Britaniyaliklar telefonda NARIGI
  tomondagi odamni 'THAT' deb ataydi
  (uzoqda, ko'rinmaydi).

  ⚠ Amerikaliklar esa 'THIS' deydi.

  ⚠ O'zingizni tanishtirganda ikkalasida
  ham: 'THIS IS Aziz speaking.'


⚠ 5-JUFT — 'HAVE GOT' va 'DO YOU HAVE':

     BrE: 'HAVE YOU GOT a ticket?'
     AmE: 'DO YOU HAVE a ticket?'

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham EGALIK bildiradi.

  ⚠ 'have got' — BrE da ko'proq;
  ⚠ 'do you have' — AmE da ko'proq,
     lekin BrE da ham ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ INKOR:
     BrE: 'I haven't got a car.'
     AmE: 'I don't have a car.'

  ⚠ Kitobda 'have got' asosiy shakl
  sifatida o'rgatilgan (Photo File 3-unit varag'i va
  boshqalar).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  grammar     = grammatika
  spelling    = imlo
  a preposition = predlog
  a particle  = yuklama (up, in, off ...)
  an expression = ibora
  to hand in  = topshirmoq
  a report    = hisobot

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling: match the American spelling to the British spelling.
exercises.instructionUz: Imlo: Amerika imlosini Britaniya imlosi bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'SPELLING' BO'LIMI — 15 JUFT.

  ⚠ Bu so'zlar bir xil o'qiladi (bittadan
  tashqari), faqat IMLOsi boshqa.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT (AmE → BrE):

  aluminum      → aluminium
  analyze       → analyse
  center        → centre
  check (n)     → cheque (n)
  color         → colour
  defense       → defence
  honor         → honour
  jewelry       → jewellery
  labor         → labour
  practice (n,v) → practice (n),
                   practise (v)
  program       → programme
  realize       → realise
  theater       → theatre
  tire          → tyre
  trave(l)ler   → traveller


⚠⚠ BESh ASOSIY QOIDA:

  1) '-OR' → '-OUR'
     color → colour
     honor → honour
     labor → labour
     ⚠ Yana: favor/favour,
       neighbor/neighbour

  2) '-ER' → '-RE'
     center → centre
     theater → theatre
     ⚠ Yana: meter/metre, liter/litre

  3) '-IZE' → '-ISE'
     analyze → analyse
     realize → realise
     ⚠ Yana: organize/organise

  4) '-SE' → '-CE'
     defense → defence
     ⚠ Yana: offense/offence,
       license/licence

  5) BITTA 'L' → IKKITA 'L'
     traveler → traveller
     ⚠ Yana: traveling/travelling,
       canceled/cancelled


⚠⚠ 'PRACTICE / PRACTISE' — ENG NOZIK:

  BRITANIYADA ot va fe'l BOShQAChA
  yoziladi:

     'practiCe' — OT   ('c' bilan)
        'football practice'
     'practiSe' — FE'L ('s' bilan)
        'to practise the piano'

  ⚠ Amerikada IKKALASI ham 'practice'.

  ⚠⚠ PHOTO FILE 14-UNIT VARAG'IDAGI 'ADVICE/ADVISE' BILAN
  BIR XIL QOIDA:
     'adviCe' — OT
     'adviSe' — FE'L

  ⚠ Eslab qolish: alifboda 'C' 'S' dan
  OLDIN — otda ham 'C' oldin keladi.


⚠ 'CHECK / CHEQUE' — DIQQAT:

     BrE 'a cheque' = BANK ChEKI
     BrE 'a check' = tekshiruv

  ⚠ Ya'ni Britaniyada IKKALA so'z ham bor,
  lekin MA'NOSI BOShQA!

  ⚠ 164-betda ko'rgan edik: AmE 'check
  (restaurant)' = BrE 'bill'.


⚠⚠ HALOL IZOH — 'REALIZE':

  Kitob 'realize → realise' deb bergan.

  ⚠ Aslida BRITANIYADA '-IZE' ShAKLI HAM
  TO'G'RI. Oksford lug'ati aynan '-ize'
  ni afzal ko'radi.

  ⚠ '-ise' esa keng tarqalgan va
  gazetalarda ko'proq ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham xato emas — asosiysi
  BIR MATNDA ARALAShTIRMASLIK.


⚠⚠ HALOL IZOH — 'ALUMINUM':

  Bu faqat imlo farqi EMAS —
  TALAFFUZ ham boshqa:

     AmE 'aluminum'  [a-LU-mi-nam]
        — 4 bo'g'in
     BrE 'aluminium' [al-yu-MIN-i-am]
        — 5 bo'g'in

  ⚠ BrE shaklida qo'shimcha 'i' bor.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  aluminium   = alyuminiy (BrE)
  to analyse  = tahlil qilmoq (BrE)
  a cheque    = bank cheki (BrE)
  defence     = mudofaa (BrE)
  honour      = sharaf (BrE)
  jewellery   = zargarlik buyumlari (BrE)
  labour      = mehnat (BrE)
  to practise = mashq qilmoq (BrE, FE'L)
  practice    = mashq (BrE, OT)
  a programme = dastur (BrE)
  to realise  = anglamoq (BrE)
  a theatre   = teatr (BrE)
  a tyre      = shina (BrE)
  a traveller = sayohatchi (BrE)

exercises.instructionEn: Expressions with prepositions and particles: match the American expression to the British one.
exercises.instructionUz: Predlog va yuklamali iboralar: Amerika iborasini Britaniya iborasi bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'EXPRESSIONS WITH PREPOSITIONS AND
PARTICLES' — 7 JUFT.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT (AmE → BrE):

  different from/than → different from/to
  live on X street    → live in X street
  on a team           → in a team
  on the weekend      → at the weekend
  Monday through Friday → Monday to Friday
  be in the hospital  → be in hospital
  in the future       → in future


⚠ 'A PREPOSITION' va 'A PARTICLE':

     'a preposition' = PREDLOG
        (in, on, at, from, to)
     'a particle' = YUKLAMA
        (up, off, out — frazali
         fe'llardagi qismlar)


⚠⚠ 159-BETDAGI QOIDA TASDIQLANDI:

  159-betda yozgan edik: 'different FROM'
  — Britaniyada 'different than' EMAS.

  ⚠ Bu bet buni tasdiqlaydi:
     AmE: different from/THAN
     BrE: different from/TO

  ⚠ 'different FROM' — IKKALA mamlakatda
  ham to'g'ri, eng xavfsiz variant.


⚠⚠ 'IN HOSPITAL' — MUHIM BRITANCHA QOIDA:

     BrE: 'He is IN HOSPITAL.'
        = U kasalxonada YOTIBDI (bemor).
     BrE: 'He is IN THE HOSPITAL.'
        = U kasalxona BINOSIDA (masalan,
          ishlaydi yoki mehmonga kelgan).

  ⚠ Britaniyada muassasada O'Z VAZIFASI
  bo'yicha bo'lsa ARTIKL TUShADI:

     at school   — o'qiyapti
     at the school — maktab binosida
     in prison   — qamalgan
     in the prison — qamoqxona binosida
     at church   — ibodat qilyapti
     at the church — cherkov binosida

  ⚠ Amerikada esa 'in THE hospital'
  deyiladi.


⚠⚠ HALOL IZOH — 'IN FUTURE':

  Kitob 'in the future → in future' deb
  bergan.

  ⚠ Aslida BRITANIYADA IKKALASI HAM BOR,
  lekin MA'NOSI BOShQA:

     'IN FUTURE' = BUNDAN KEYIN
        'In future, please be on time.'
        = Bundan keyin vaqtida keling.

     'IN THE FUTURE' = KELAJAKDA
        (qachondir)
        'In the future, cars will fly.'
        = Kelajakda mashinalar uchadi.

  ⚠ Ya'ni bu oddiy AmE/BrE farqi emas —
  ikki BOShQA ibora.


⚠ 'AT THE WEEKEND' — BRITANChA:

     BrE: 'What do you do AT the weekend?'
     AmE: 'What do you do ON the weekend?'

  ⚠ Kitob BrE da — mashqlarda 'AT the
  weekend' yozing.


⚠ 'MONDAY TO FRIDAY':

     BrE: 'Monday TO Friday'
     AmE: 'Monday THROUGH Friday'

  ⚠ AmE 'through' aniqroq: juma KIRADI.
  ⚠ BrE 'to' esa biroz noaniq, shuning
  uchun ba'zan 'Monday to Friday
  INCLUSIVE' deyiladi.


⚠ 'IN X STREET' va 'ON X STREET':

     BrE: 'I live IN Oxford Street.'
     AmE: 'I live ON Oxford Street.'

  ⚠ Lekin ikkalasida ham aniq uy raqami
  bilan 'AT':
     'I live AT 12 Oxford Street.'

  ⚠ Photo File 14-unit varag'idagi xat manzili shu qolipda
  edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a preposition = predlog
  a particle    = yuklama
  an expression = ibora
  a team        = jamoa
  the weekend   = dam olish kunlari
  a hospital    = kasalxona
  the future    = kelajak
  inclusive     = shu jumladan

wordFormation.explanationUz: AmE va BrE qanday farq qiladi.

wordFormation.ruleUz: ⚠⚠ BIR SO'Z — IKKI MAMLAKATDA IKKI MA'NO
wordFormation.explanationUz: Eng ehtiyot bo'lish kerak bo'lgan so'zlar.

wordFormation.ruleUz: ⚠⚠ XAVFLI JUFTLAR — BIR SO'Z, IKKI MA'NO

items.derivedUz: BrE da davlat maktabi = state school

wordFormation.explanationUz: Alifbo va raqamlarda ham farq bor.

sentencePatterns.formula: In British English, [AmE so'z] is called [BrE so'z].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In British English, an elevator is called a lift.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Farqlarni tushuntirish qolipi.
⚠ 'is called' — majhul nisbat.

sentencePatterns.formula: Americans say [A], while the British say [B].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Americans say 'truck', while the British say 'lorry'.

sentencePatterns.formula: A single to [joy], please.  /  A return to [joy], please.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Britaniya kassasida chipta so'rash.
AmE: 'A round trip to Boston, please.'

sentencePatterns.formula: In Britain people say [BrE], but in America they say [AmE].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In Britain people say 'autumn', but in America they say 'fall'.

sentencePatterns.formula: [So'z] means [A] in American English and [B] in British English.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: 'Pants' means trousers in American English and underwear in British English.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 'Pants' Amerika inglizchasida shim, Britaniya inglizchasida ichki kiyim degani.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Bir so'zning ikki ma'nosini
tushuntirish uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm going on holiday for a fortnight.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm going on holiday for a fortnight.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Sof britancha gap: 'holiday' +
'fortnight'.
AmE: 'I'm going on vacation for two
weeks.'

⚠ BrE: 'just' bilan PRESENT PERFECT.
⚠ 'just' — 'has' va fe'l ORASIDA.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has he handed in the report yet?

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ BrE egalik savoli.
AmE: 'Do you have a ticket?'

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hello, is that David?  -  Yes, this is David speaking.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Alo, bu Devidmi? — Ha, bu Devid.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ BrE telefonda 'THAT' (narigi tomon).
⚠ O'zini tanishtirganda 'THIS IS'.

sentencePatterns.formula: What do you do at the weekend?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What do you do at the weekend?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ BrE: 'AT the weekend';
AmE: 'ON the weekend'.
